_meta.purpose: The general cybersecurity, physical, legal and operational starter templates. Ids are the slug the original seed derived from each title (title, whitespace to '-', lower-cased, first 25 characters), kept so existing rows are updated in place rather than duplicated.
_meta.origin: Moved verbatim from the inline `riskTemplates` array in prisma/seed.ts (2026-11-08), so production receives it: prisma/seed.ts is never run on a deploy.
_meta.deliveredBy: scripts/seed-risk-templates.ts on every container start (scripts/entrypoint.sh), and prisma/seed.ts in dev, both through prisma/risk-template-fixtures.ts.
